source.kind: historical offline experiments, generated from repository Parquet only

warehouse.architecture_notes: Source raw CSV = conceptual landing/data-lake zone; parquet warehouse = curated dimensional fact/dimension export. No live data-lake service, ingestion stream, S3 or object-store instance is deployed.

schema_models.snowflake: Conceptual normalized dimensions only, not an additional deployed model
schema_models.constellation: Actual shared customer/product/seller dimensions connected to order and item facts

classification.selection: Chronological 77/23 split; train-fitted transforms; fixed 0.5 decision threshold; no test-set tuning.

regression.notes: Delivered orders only, target purchase-to-receipt days. Features available near purchase, but delivered-only selection biases estimates. No future labels in features.

clustering.caveats: Clustering is exploratory and trained on a 950-person deterministic sample. Ward dendrogram uses at most 52 of that sample; bisecting k-means is a divisive partition, not a complete divisive dendrogram.

patterns.caveats: Support denominators use eligible >=2-category baskets among top 36 translated categories. Many Olist orders have one category; do not generalize associations to all purchases. Algorithm timing measured during export hardware only; not a controlled benchmark.
